contract: A partial batch can accept one locked offset and refuse an offset that was never delivered. The refused offset is not accepted.
Release and leader loss return a locked offset without accepting it. A renewed lock survives an earlier deadline and is released at the new deadline.
Reopen keeps the accepted offset and the in-flight lock. Expiry after reopen releases the lock and does not accept it.
A record at the delivery limit is not locked again and is not accepted.
limits: This is not the ShareFetch or ShareAcknowledge RPC.
The journal format is the local PLSHD001 snapshot.
Not a production qualification and not a fastest-server claim.
